cards.note: Already the official npm-package bundle form: dsh.bundle.patch points at cordis.patch.yml, whose insert row names the bare package name; no dsh.plugin.json and no repository-plugins row exists.
The manifest declares dsh.client (the merged field, platform web + ./client export); no legacy dshClient field and no dsh.plugin.json anywhere.
The browser half declares dsh.client with platform web and a resolvable ./client export, so the client-modules scan includes it; the card's hit condition (missing declaration) is not met.

Client inject now declares slots/locale/sessions/settingsScope (settingsScope was the documented card wire and was missing, which strict injection would have turned into a throw at apply); host declares settings; optional layout/betterLocale stay weak ctx.get probes.

Optional host services are already probed weakly (ctx.get('layout') and ctx.get('betterLocale') with undefined checks) and degrade to the private writer / no-op; no hard dependency or property read needed fixing.
No session/event subscription and no event-field discriminator: session state comes from the client sessions.list snapshot store, not from the event log.

Slot-based, not self-rendering: alpha.2 still provides ctx.sessions (ISessions from dsh-api-session-controller) and the plugin declares it in inject; the fallback title writer reads sessions.list (current/byId.title), which exists at alpha.2.
No tasks/jobs tailing or peek API anywhere in the plugin.

No httpServer/tasks/onTaskDone identifier remains; the pre-migration baseline already used the post-rename webServer spelling, and this migration retires that route entirely in favour of the settings domain.
No image attachment refs, read_image results, or persisted image metadata.
The plugin registers no read_image wrapper, host integration, or snapshot assertion.
No DeepSeek LLM adapter, image request interceptor, or attachment/upload cache.

No apiProxy/executeRemote call site and no dsh-host-apiproxy dependency; the retired 0.4.x route was a plain webServer HTTP route, and the card's section now travels the official settings RPC through ctx.settingsScope.
The plugin produces no third-party persisted SessionEvents, and the migration target is alpha.2, where DSH-0.1.2-A2-01 restores the marker.
No host source patch and no imports from internal session-view paths; the only session read is the public ctx.sessions list snapshot.
Not a launcher wrapper, SDK/ACP integration, or profile reader: the plugin only ships its own bundle patch overlay and never hardcodes a profile path.
No headless wrapper or stdout/stderr parser; the plugin ships no process-level entry point.
No tool presentation mode, PTC preset, dispatch waterfall, or related type usage.
No permission/approval/WebFetch policy plugin and no tools/pre-execute policy of its own.

The 0.4.x custom /bench-brand-text/api route on webServer is retired for the official settings wire, so no custom loopback HTTP channel remains to carry the bootstrap-token/signed-cookie gate; the card's condition was met by the pre-migration route and is resolved by removing it.
Not a model-provider plugin and carries no provider-login patch to retire (capability card, no public entry adopted).
Registers namespace dictionaries for the shipped zh/en languages through the official ctx.locale; it registers no third-party language and carries no custom i18n patch to replace.
No subagent orchestration or provider/model/reasoning selector.
Informational deployment card: the plugin neither ships nor configures the official DeepSeek adapter, and its own copy makes no attribution claim.
No persistent PowerShell/Bash or Windows directory-picker workaround exists to delete.
Deployment opt-in privacy card: the plugin does not enable or configure session-log-deepseek and sends no session logs.

The repository ships no browser acceptance script or wrapper that could hardcode the web root URL, bundle path, or startup-log format; the fixture's container never executes the browser half (its bundle artifact is elided), so no acceptance run was possible here.
No userQuestions.registerProvider or user-questions/request answerer registration.
No agent-preset inference, session-preset resolution, or agent-presets root configuration.
No token-delta detection, TPS computation, or dsh-llm/message import.
The bundle layer only inserts its own row; it reuses no dsh-base rows, declares no telemetry stance, and configures no session-telemetry or package-inventory row.
No @earendil-works/pi-ai dependency and no provider/auth plugin code.

Snapshot-store engine retargeted to the baseline @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store (the removed dsh-client-runtime aggregation package is out of dsh.client.inject and both peer tables; baseline externals are implicit, so it gets no manifest entry).

The assembly row names the bare package name (@bench/dsh-bench-brand-text) and the client bundle registration id is build-stamped from package.json#name by the shared preset; no file:/// or short-name row form remains.
No conversation-node/timeline reads: the fallback title writer reads only the sessions.list metadata snapshot (current + byId[id].title).
No composer DOM manipulation, draft injection, or selection/caret work.
Renders no MarkdownText/fenced CodeBlock from ui-primitives; the card and occupant bodies are plugin-owned.
No ctx.connection.api usage: the card binds ctx.settingsScope and the title fallback reads ctx.sessions.list, both of which survive at alpha.2.
No subagent seed/persisted descriptors and no subagent/descriptor consumers.
No ctx.workspaces list/CRUD or connectWorkspace/pickDirectory/listDirectory/createDirectory navigation calls.
No third-party persisted SessionEvents or persistence/reload/transport seam owned by the plugin.
No direct ctx.remote call site or Remote failure handling: the card's writes go through ctx.settingsScope, which owns the Remote result/error flow.

Peers recomposed to the alpha.2 cohort (exact 0.1.2-alpha.2 DSH peers, cordis ^4.0.1 which admits the shipped 4.0.2) and every declared dsh.client.inject edge now has a matching peer; the skill inject-lint reports peersMissingForInject/peersMissingForImports empty.
No startup wrapper or CI matrix entry that forces Node 22 or skips dsh web; the local runtime is Node 24.21.0, outside the 24.0-24.11.1 failure window.
Does not consume pluginInventory/list or validate PluginInventorySnapshot.
No host.describe call, no connection-generation coupling, and no $host.home/isLoopback read.

Does not compose a profile that mounts dsh-tool-todo/subagent/agent/agent-loop/terminal-bash individually; the plugin runs as one row inside the shipped web bundle, so the sessionProjections inject/peer is supplied by dsh-base.

The host half registers through ctx.settings.installSection with the literal namespace 'bench-brand-text' and never imported the removed settingsNamespace helper, so the compile-time SettingsNamespaceInput change is not hit.
